data.topic: 会话1 · Dialogue 1 (Meeting Mr. Li at the Airport)

items.zh: 王大年：您好，李先生！我是王大年，公司的翻译。
items.py: Wáng Dànián: Nín hǎo, Lǐ xiānsheng! Wǒ shì Wáng Dànián, gōngsī de fānyì.
items.en: Wang Danian: Hello, Mr. Li! I'm Wang Danian, the company's interpreter.

items.py: Lǐ: Xièxie nín lái jiē wǒ.
items.en: Li: Thank you for coming to pick me up.

items.zh: 王大年：别客气。路上辛苦了。累了吧？
items.py: Wáng Dànián: Bié kèqi. Lù shang xīnkǔ le. Lèi le ba?
items.en: Wang Danian: You're welcome. You must be tired from the trip. Tired?

items.zh: 李：一点儿也不累，很顺利。
items.py: Lǐ: Yīdiǎnr yě bù lèi, hěn shùnlì.
items.en: Li: Not tired at all, the trip was smooth.

items.zh: 王大年：汽车在外边，我们送您去饭店。
items.py: Wáng Dànián: Qìchē zài wàibian, wǒmen sòng nín qù fàndiàn.
items.en: Wang Danian: The car is outside. We'll take you to the hotel.

items.py: Lǐ: Wǒ hái yǒu liǎng ge péngyou.
items.en: Li: I have two more friends with me.

items.py: Wáng Dànián: Nà yìqǐ zǒu ba.
items.en: Wang Danian: Then let's all go together.

items.py: Lǐ: Xièxie!
items.en: Li: Thank you!

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (Manager Welcomes Mr. Li)

items.py: Jīnglǐ: Huānyíng nín, Lǐ xiānsheng!
items.en: Manager: Welcome, Mr. Li!

items.py: Lǐ: Xièxie!
items.en: Li: Thank you!

items.zh: 经理：您第一次来中国吗？
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Nín dì yī cì lái Zhōngguó ma?
items.en: Manager: Is this your first time in China?

items.zh: 李：不，我以前来过两次。这是我们经理给您的信。
items.py: Lǐ: Bù, wǒ yǐqián lái guo liǎng cì. Zhè shì wǒmen jīnglǐ gěi nín de xìn.
items.en: Li: No, I've been here twice before. Here is a letter from our manager.

items.py: Jīnglǐ: Máfan nín le.
items.en: Manager: Sorry for the trouble.

items.py: Lǐ: Tā wèn nín hǎo.
items.en: Li: He sends his regards.

items.zh: 经理：谢谢。今天我们在北京饭店请您吃晚饭。
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Xièxie. Jīntiān wǒmen zài Běijīng Fàndiàn qǐng nín chī wǎnfàn.
items.en: Manager: Thank you. Today we'll treat you to dinner at Beijing Hotel.

items.zh: 李：您太客气了，真不好意思。
items.py: Lǐ: Nín tài kèqi le, zhēn bù hǎoyìsi.
items.en: Li: You're too kind, I'm really embarrassed.

items.py: Jīnglǐ: Nín yǒu shíjiān ma?
items.en: Manager: Do you have time?

items.zh: 李：下午我去朋友那儿，晚上没有事。
items.py: Lǐ: Xiàwǔ wǒ qù péngyou nàr, wǎnshang méi yǒu shì.
items.en: Li: In the afternoon I'll visit my friend, but I'm free in the evening.

items.py: Jīnglǐ: Wǒmen qù jiē nín.
items.en: Manager: We'll pick you up.

items.zh: 李：不用了，我可以打车从朋友那儿去。
items.py: Lǐ: Bú yòng le, wǒ kěyǐ dǎ chē cóng péngyou nàr qù.
items.en: Li: No need, I can take a taxi from my friend's place.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ shénme shíhou zǒu?
items.en: Liu Jing: When are you leaving?

items.py: Dàwèi: Hòutiān shàngwǔ de fēijī.
items.en: David: The day after tomorrow, morning flight.

items.zh: 刘京：东西都准备好了吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: Have you got everything ready?

items.zh: 大卫：准备好了。我买了一些礼物。
items.py: Dàwèi: Zhǔnbèi hǎo le. Wǒ mǎi le yīxiē lǐwù.
items.en: David: Yes. I've bought some gifts.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Hòutiān wǒ qù sòng nǐ.
items.en: Liu Jing: I'll see you off the day after tomorrow.

items.zh: 大卫：不用了，太麻烦你了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Bú yòng le, tài máfan nǐ le.
items.en: David: No need, it's too much trouble.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Bù máfan. Wǒ yīdìng qù!
items.en: Liu Jing: No trouble. I'll definitely go!

items.py: Dàwèi: Nà tài hǎo le! Xièxie nǐ.
items.en: David: That's great! Thank you.

data.topic: 会话4 · Dialogue 4 (At the Airport — Farewell)

items.zh: 刘京：时间不早了，你该进去了。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, nǐ gāi jìnqù le.
items.en: Liu Jing: It's getting late, you should go in.

items.zh: 大卫：是啊。谢谢你这半年对我的帮助。
items.py: Dàwèi: Shì a. Xièxie nǐ zhè bàn nián duì wǒ de bāngzhù.
items.en: David: Yes. Thank you for your help these past six months.

items.zh: 刘京：别客气，我们是好朋友。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Bié kèqi, wǒmen shì hǎo péngyou.
items.en: Liu Jing: Don't mention it, we're good friends.

items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ huì xiǎng nǐmen de.
items.en: David: I'll miss you all.

items.zh: 刘京：我们也会想你的。到了以后给我打电话。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Wǒmen yě huì xiǎng nǐ de. Dào le yǐhòu gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: Liu Jing: We'll miss you too. Call me when you arrive.

items.zh: 大卫：一定。欢迎你来美国玩。
items.py: Dàwèi: Yīdìng. Huānyíng nǐ lái Měiguó wán.
items.en: David: For sure. You're welcome to visit America.

items.zh: 刘京：好的。祝你一路平安！
items.py: Liú Jīng: Hǎo de. Zhù nǐ yīlù píng'ān!
items.en: Liu Jing: OK. Have a safe journey!

items.py: Dàwèi: Zàijiàn!
items.en: David: Goodbye!
